verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Computer runs code in a sandboxed Linux VM with Python, Node.js, and Unix tools and a persistent file workspace. It processes CSV, JSON, Excel, PDF, and media files, accepts uploads up to 200 MB, and analyzes data from sources like Snowflake and Google Sheets. It can also create PDFs, spreadsheets, slide decks, and images, which covers the core of writing and running code on user data to produce outputs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of chart generation, an explicit file-download mechanism for generated artifacts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the code-execution and analysis workflow.
